data.one_liner: Widgets to implement glass morphism effects in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides customized container widgets that implement glassmorphism styling, including frosted glass, custom gradients, borders, and blur effects.
use_when: You want to build a modern UI featuring glassmorphic cards, dialogs, or containers.
You need an easy way to apply blur, gradient borders, and translucency to child widgets.
avoid_when: You need standard material design components without custom glass visual effects.
Performance on very low-end devices is a strict priority and heavy blurring causes frame drops.
strengths: Simple constructors like clearGlass and frostedGlass for rapid implementation.
Highly customizable via gradient borders, custom blur, and opacity settings.
weaknesses: Heavy use of blur and transparency can impact rendering performance on certain hardware.

alternatives.name: liquid_glass_widgets
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative package providing liquid glass or glassmorphism-style widgets.
